Title: [Q:LSJ] Playtesting of CE Card Changes (Fifth, Majesty, etc.)

Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:
Hi LSJ,

There is obviously lots of controversy over the "leaked" card text
changes such as Fifth Tradition and Majesty. I know that the
playtesters for the Camarilla Edition were given many of the vampires,
but did they also playtest the changes to existing cards?

I know it would put my mind at ease a bit to know absolutely that the
changes were made after both considerable thought (I credit you this a
priori) and considerable testing (I have no idea whether this was part
of the playtesting procedure or not). Thanks!

Jeff

Messages.Author: LSJ

I saw it, but I didn't see the need to respond.

Obviously (or not, depending on your perspective) considerable
thought and testing goes into changing whatever rules and cards
get changed, for certain values of "considerable" (you may have
different values).

My saying so is a given, though, so people who would disagree will
not find anything of use in it (nor should people who agree actually
find anything novel in the statement).
